course_name_original: Messtechnik und Datenerfassung in der Fertigung (MTDE)
course_name_en: Measurement Technology and Data Acquisition in Manufacturing (MTDE)
prerequisites: Prior knowledge of manufacturing processes and manufacturing systems

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the fundamentals of measurement technology and its importance in manufacturing.

Identify various measurement procedures, including tactile and optical measurement systems, interpret their accuracy specifications, and relate them to precision and accuracy requirements in manufacturing measurement technology.
Describe the procedures for data acquisition and evaluation in manufacturing.
Select suitable measuring instruments for specific manufacturing tasks according to requirements.
Understand and apply the principles of statistical process control (SPC).
Explain the integration of measurement systems into digital manufacturing processes (Industry 4.0) and their requirements and benefits.
Apply theoretical knowledge in practical measurement technology projects and implement it purposefully.
Collaborate interdisciplinarily in a team and jointly solve technical tasks.
Reflect on the importance of measurement technology and data acquisition in modern manufacturing processes.
Independently continue education and recognize and evaluate new developments in the field of measurement technology and their integration into manufacturing systems.
Analytically and creatively solve technical problems in the field of measurement technology and data acquisition.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to measurement technology: Fundamentals and importance in manufacturing.
Measuring devices and measurement procedures: Classification, selection, application and calibration.
Data acquisition systems: Hardware, software and interfaces.
Analog and digital measurement procedures: Advantages and disadvantages, fields of application.
Accuracy specifications and measurement uncertainty: Definition, calculation and application.
Statistical Process Control (SPC): Principles, methods and applications.
Integration of measurement systems into manufacturing processes: Automation and networking.
Application of measurement technology in quality assurance: Methods and tools.
Ecological and economic aspects of measurement technology: Evaluation and optimization.
Case studies and practical applications: Examples from industrial practice.
Understanding the interactions between measurement technology, manufacturing processes and other technical, economic and environmental aspects.
Development of skills for independent learning and the acquisition of new knowledge as well as adaptation to technological innovations and continuous further education.
Application of communication skills for creating reports, documentation.
Evaluation of the economic and ecological effects of measurement technology and data acquisition in manufacturing.
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam. Successful participation in the practical course is a prerequisite for taking the exam. The weighting of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
